## Problem and desired outcome

Describe the use case and the proposed behavior. Clearly distinguish the proposal from implemented capabilities.

## Proposed change

Identify affected stages and alternatives. For end-to-end integration or AlphaGenome Atlas loop integration, describe the missing connection explicitly: neither is currently complete.

## Evidence constraints

Explain effects on allowed actions, planner guardrails, deterministic verification, abstention/stopping, or fixed-fact reporting. Strong terminal decisions require admissible direct experimental evidence; JASPAR and cCRE cannot independently establish TF binding. Neither Anthropic planning nor prose reporting may override the scientific verdict.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe observable outcomes and suitable validation. Do not treat the current small demonstration as evidence of predictive accuracy, autonomous discovery, or clinical utility.

## Data and configuration

List required resources and configuration using neutral placeholders. Do not attach secrets, weights, databases, large results, or user-specific server paths.
